Global Income Fixed Fund

The Global Fixed Income Fund is a specialized open-ended dollar-denominated fund that invests in securities and Eurobonds, floated by the federal government of Nigeria and other sovereigns. The fund also invests in top-tier corporates, money market instruments and alternative investment assets.

The main objective is to achieve consistent income streams through investment in select dollar-denominated global Fixed income securities issued by non-Nigerian issuers, sovereign as well as top-tier corporate Eurobonds. Subscribers can expect to receive competitive short to medium-term capital appreciation on their USD holdings invested in the Fund better than they would receive on domiciliary deposits.

Benefits and Features of the fund:

  • Exposure to a broader range of asset classes
  • Capital preservation
  • Attractive returns
  • Portfolio diversification
  • Open entry and exit
  • Hedge against inflation

The United Capital Global Fixed Income Fund offers 3,000,000 units of $1.00 each at par with a minimum investable amount of $50,000 and multiples of $500.
